long_biography.plain_text:
Stevanato spent school holidays in the glass business Giovanni Stevanato established near Venice, learning production before completing a law degree at Ferrara. After graduating in 1969, he joined full time, adding commercial and organisational leadership to his father's technical expertise. He later assumed full responsibility for the group and backed the creation of in-house glass-forming machinery.

Under his stewardship, the company broadened from pharmaceutical containers into inspection systems, assembly equipment, diagnostic components and drug-delivery devices. Acquisitions and international plants turned a regional manufacturer into a global healthcare supplier, while a New York listing opened its ownership to public investors. Stevanato now serves as chairman emeritus; his sons hold executive leadership, and the family holding preserves decisive voting influence.
